decisions.decision: Historical Turn/Rebuke/Command/Bolster/Dispel checks and modern Turn Undead/Divine Spark are separate effects sharing one Channel Divinity pool. Two uses from level 1, three at level 6, four at level 18; one use returned on Short Rest, all on Long Rest; historical 3+Charisma daily uses not additive. No alignment prerequisites. Preserve both historic turning check and modern save procedures as alternatives.
decisions.decisionBasis: Owner approval, 2026-10-19, one resource with multiple effects and no forced alignment

decisions.decision: From level 10, Direct Intervention grants eligible level <=5 Cleric spell without slot/materials each Long Rest; Divine Supplication makes a percentile request with seven-day cooldown on success and Long Rest reset on failure. At level 20, Supplication success is automatic and Direct Intervention can invoke Wish with 2d4 Long Rest cooldown. Neither procedure removes the other.
decisions.decisionBasis: Owner approval, 2026-10-19, two distinct modes with source recovery procedures

decisions.decision: Creature size is a normal, mandatory property in Wild Shape eligibility; it is not optional/advanced complexity. Incorporate source-supported historical size progression (3.5: Small/Medium L5, Large L8, Tiny L11, Huge L15) into base-class form eligibility while preserving modern L2 Wild Shape. Resolving exact combined CR, HD and size constraints and HP rules remains open.

decisions.decision: Use the 3.5e persistent Animal Companion from Druid level 1; companion persists between encounters/rests, advances by its documented bonus Hit Dice, armor, abilities and tricks, and is released/replaced by the source ceremony. This is a base-class grant, not a Druid Circle feature, and is distinct from 5.5e temporary Wild Companion, whose simultaneous availability remains to be settled.

decisions.decision: Wild Shape uses a separate creature-form HP pool. A beast form reaching 0 HP immediately reverts, leaving normal Druid HP unchanged; NO overflow damage passes to normal HP. This intentionally differs from official 2014 excess-damage-carryover and 2024 temporary-HP behavior, and excludes stacking them.
decisions.decisionBasis: Owner explicit preference and correction, 2026-10-20; Dorks & Dice custom house rule, not literal SRD 5.1

decisions.decision: Use 2024 finite Wild Shape charges (2 from level 2, 3 at 6, 4 at 18), Short Rest restores one, Long Rest restores all. Historical familiar animal/plant/elemental forms use ordinary type/size/HD gates as an alternative to modern CR/known-beast gates, without intersecting incompatible restrictions; maintain separate 3.5e elemental limits. Archdruid at 20 transforms without spending finite charges, but Nature Magician and Wild Resurgence spell conversions require actual finite charges and never consume unlimited transformation permission.

Persistent 3.5e Animal Companion and temporary 5.5e Wild Companion may both be present. Wild Companion requires its actual spell slot or finite Wild Shape charge; no free actions or attacks beyond native controlled-creature action and initiative rules. The temporary familiar never changes the persistent companion's lifetime or progression.

Historical nonmetal armor and shields are optional cultural or personal commitments, not mandatory class limitations; wearing otherwise proficient metal armor or shields does not disable Druid spellcasting, Wild Shape, class progression or features.
